defectsFixed.defect: path-build --version was hard-coded as 1.0.1-s5-surface while package.json and pathcode report 1.0.1.
defectsFixed.fix: Resolve path-build's version from the installed package metadata and cover it with a surface regression test.

defectsFixed.defect: Coordinator recovery omitted live Gateway snapshots, complete records skipped startup reconciliation, interruption controls could race long autonomous loops, and branchless adoption could claim success without proving the source commit reached product HEAD.
defectsFixed.fix: Expose snapshotTask, recover every durable record on startup, release the mutation gate between cognitive children while preempting active Gateway tasks before serialized stop/message mutation, and require Git ancestry proof for branchless/in-place source commits.
